assertions.rationale: It calls .AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions(options => options.UseSqlServer(...)); the EF store is configured rather than relying on the in-memory store alone.

assertions.assertion: Configures UseSqlServer with the connection string from configuration
assertions.rationale: UseSqlServer(connectionString) is used with connectionString from GetConnectionString("BffSessions").
It relies on the removed v3 option EnableSessionCleanup = true rather than calling the v4 .AddSessionCleanupBackgroundProcess().

assertions.assertion: Warns against or does NOT use in-memory sessions for production
assertions.rationale: The final configuration uses the EF/SQL Server store for production and does not rely on in-memory sessions.
